verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਦੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਪੁਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddee aarajaa i(n)dhr dhee i(n)dhrapuree vich raaj kamaavai|

en.bdb: Indr has a long age; he ruled indrpuri.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਦਹ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਦਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਿਵਸੁ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: chaudheh i(n)dhr vinaas kaal brahame dhaa ik dhivas vihaavai|

en.bdb: When fourteen Indrs are finished, the one day of Brahma passes I.e. in one day of Brahma fourteen Indrs rule.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧੇ ਹੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਮਰੈ ਲੋਮਸ ਦਾ ਇਕੁ ਰੋਮ ਛਿਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)dhe hee brahamaa marai lomas dhaa ik rom chhijaavai|

en.bdb: With the fall of one hair of Lomas Rishi, one Brahma is known to end his life (one can very well guess that like innumerable hair Brahmas are also many).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਸ ਮਹੇਸ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਚਿਰੰਜੀਵ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ses mahes vakhaaneean chira(n)jeev hoi saa(n)t na aavai|

en.bdb: Sesanag and Mahesa are also supposed to be living eternally but none has attained peace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਘਣੇ ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: jog bhog jap tap ghane lok vedh simaran na suhaavai|

en.bdb: God does not like the hypocrisy of yoga, hedonism, recitation, asceticism, common customary acts etc.
He who keeps his ego with him cannot merge in equipoise.
